operations.description: The black precipitate can be redissolved in toluene, hexane or chloroform. The source does not select a universal solvent or final concentration. Table 1 visibly prints approximately 46, 35 and 1.52 nm without clear range separators; the adjacent prose separately reports 4–5.5, 3–5 and 1.5–2 nm. These are preserved side by side, not silently repaired.
Table 1 has blank continuation cells. Filled values are source reported; continued group settings are labelled inherited rather than independently reported for that row.
Physical batch identities and many links between size-labelled figures and individual temperature/time rows are not supplied. Equal sizes do not establish a common batch.
No source coordinates, measured atomic unit cell, lattice-parameter number or unique ligand conformation are supplied. Chemically disordered fcc CoPt3 is distinct from particle superlattice packing.
